Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows discrete areas of hypotransparency (opacities) in the upper zones of both hemithoraces, with the opacity on the right side being visibly larger and more pronounced than on the left. This asymmetry, combined with the presence of bilateral findings, suggests a progression or extension of pathology rather than a strictly unilateral process like simple community-acquired pneumonia limited to one side.
